solutions.title: Email graph DFS
solutions.strategy: Build an undirected email graph and collect connected components.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each email edge is traversed and component emails are sorted.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The graph, visited set, and output components store the emails.

solutions.title: Union find
solutions.strategy: Union emails that appear in the same account, then group emails by representative.

timeComplexity.explanation: Union/find is near-constant and each group is sorted.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Parent maps and grouped component lists store every email.
